declarations.description: Pinned React wrapper API; native roles and caller composition are kept separately.

members.name: open
members.description: Content defaults side=bottom, align=center, sideOffset=4 and alignOffset=0. The wrapper exposes no PopoverClose component; source Root actionsRef.close or a caller-composed control closes it. Title/Description are actual exported primitive registration parts that supply the Popup name/description; the reference uses explicit IDs to make ownership auditable. Positioning/collision work belongs to the primitive, not a guessed CSS-only interaction.
